style: 16-bit pixel art game art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited night palette: plum black, deep plum, violet glow, cream, sunset orange, warm orange and gold window lights, bright terminal green only on screens. Dusk City at night: a skyline made of lit window dots, a few still stars
suffix: no people, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sunburst rays, no perspective floor grid, no scanlines, no grain, no glowing particles

assets.prompt: a bedroom desk at night, a glowing monitor with abstract green code bars, a small pixel bug creature crawling out of the screen, a window onto the night city
two doors side by side in a wall at night; the left door shut with a big gold padlock, the right door ajar with violet light spilling onto the floor, small glowing tokens rolling toward them
a dark security operations room: a wall of fifteen small monitors with green abstract bars, each with a small violet tag in the corner, one monitor turning red, an empty desk and keyboard in front
a giant generic smartphone standing in front of the night city, its screen full of blank chat bubbles, two bubbles marked with small red flags, no app logos
a wooden ladder against a tall building at night, its bottom rungs dissolving into pixels, three new glowing green rungs higher up, three small blocks stacked at its foot, a moon
stacks of gold coins rising like a bar chart inside a softly shaded band, a magenta marker pointing at one stack, one very tall stack standing apart on the right
a crossroads at night with three paths fanning out, three blank wooden signposts, the middle signpost glowing green, a moon
a cream university gate on a dark hill under the moon, three paths climbing to it, four blank flip-clock tiles in the foreground, two small flags on the gate
a large retro terminal window on a desk with rows of abstract green prompt bars and a block cursor, a small green shield beside it, a window onto the night city
a laptop open on a desk at night with green code bars, a warm desk lamp, the moon in the window, a small orange flag planted beside the laptop
a rooftop at the edge of the city just before sunrise, a thin orange band of first light on the horizon, a path of glowing tiles leading toward it, a small green flag
a vertical top-down game world map at night: five small dark islands in a deep plum sea, tiny lit windows on each island, no path, no labels
a chunky pixel picture frame, green outer border, orange corner studs, deep plum dithered interior with a few stars, empty centre
a generic friendly pixel game guide character, full body, violet hoodie, orange headset with a small mic, dark hair, standing, transparent background (not a likeness of any real person)
the same generic pixel guide character, mouth open mid-sentence, transparent background
the same generic pixel guide character cheering with both fists up and eyes closed happily, transparent background
